title: R24 TABLESTYLE property override and AutoScale flags

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.3
source.finding: Group 90 property-override bits are defined through 0x40000. Content-format override bits occupy 0x1ff; group 91 contains only the Auto Scale value bit 0x100, which is meaningful only when the matching override bit is selected.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE DXF writer now admits documented style override masks through 0x7ffff and content-format masks through 0x1ff, while requiring group-91 AutoScale to stay within 0x100 and be selected by the content-format override mask. Existing profile and value gates remain.

validation.result: Build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII/Binary controls verify group-90/group-91 field positions, typed/raw flag readback, rejection of an unknown style bit and AutoScale without its override, destination preservation, and successful same-adapter retry.

qualificationLimits: Generated codec controls do not qualify independent producer wire behavior.
Native CAD AutoScale semantics and rendering remain unqualified.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
